function.name: query_local_imessage_history
function.description: Searches the user's local Apple iMessage database for historical context. Use this when the user asks about past conversations, links, or data sent via text/iMessage. This is a secure, local-only shadow API.

search_term.description: The keyword, phrase, or name to search for in the message history.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 10).

function.name: semantic_local_file_search
function.description: Searches the user's local Mac filesystem (Documents, Photos, PDFs) by semantic concept rather than exact filename. Uses local vector embeddings. Use this when the user asks to find a vague file, document, or image based on what it contains.

concept.description: The abstract concept to search for (e.g., 'a receipt from a coffee shop', 'a photo of a beach sunset').

file_types.description: Optional file extensions to filter by (e.g., ['pdf'], ['jpg', 'png']).

function.name: adobe_suite_expert_injection
function.description: Acts as an Adobe Expert. Injects assets, creates layers, and executes complex edits directly inside Adobe applications (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere) on the user's Mac. Use this when the user wants to manipulate an image or file and send it directly into their active Adobe project.

action.description: The specific expert action to take (e.g., 'import_as_new_layer', 'apply_mask', 'export_active_artboard').

asset_path.description: The local file path of the asset to inject (if applicable).

parameters.description: Additional expert parameters (e.g., blending modes, hex colors, scale percentages).

function.name: final_cut_pro_genius_edit
function.description: Acts as a Master Video Editor. Generates Final Cut Pro XML (FCPXML) to instantly assemble timelines, apply cuts, sync audio, or apply color grades. Use this when the user wants to automatically edit video files or send a rough cut directly into Final Cut Pro.

assets.description: An array of local file paths to the raw video/audio files.

timeline_name.description: The name of the new project/timeline to create in Final Cut Pro.
